today.title: Drugs for Human Use; Drug Efficacy Study Implementation: Estrogen-Androgen Fixed-Combination Drug Products; Third Extension of Effective Date of Final Resolution of Drug Efficacy Study Implementation 7661
today.ai_summary: FDA가 Federal Register 공고로 Estrogen-Androgen 고정용량 복합제(Syntest D.S./H.S. 정제) 관련 DESI 7661 최종 결정 공고의 시행일을 추가로 연장했다. 앞서 2026년 11월 4일로 연장된 시행일이 2027년 5월 4일로 다시 연장되며, 사유는 이해관계자가 제기한 쟁점을 검토할 시간이 필요하기 때문이라고 한다. 수집된 공고 요약 발췌 기준이다.
today.source_summary: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA or Agency) is extending the effective date of the notice published in the Federal Register on May 27, 2026, titled Drugs for Human Use; Drug Efficacy Study Implementation: Estrogen-Androgen Fixed-Combination Drug Products; Syntest D.S. and Syntest H.S. Tablets; Withdrawal of Hearing Requests; Final Resolution of Drug Efficacy Study Implementation 7661 (91 FR. 31462) (the "May 2026 Notice"), as previously extended by the notice published in the Federal Register on August 27, 2026 (91 FR 55348), by an additional 6 months. The effective date of the May 2026 Notice, as previously extended to November 4, 2026, is hereby further extended to May 4, 2027. This further extension is necessary to allow FDA sufficient time to consider issues raised by interested parties.
